note: The one shared model policy for AgentKit's task skills. Each profile names a model and effort per provider; tools/model-profile.ts resolves, validates and reports them. Update IDs here, then rerun setup so Claude adapters pick them up. See docs/model-profiles.md.

model-fit.purpose: Recommend a task profile, model and effort without doing the task.

asset-craft.purpose: Inspect references and prepare or produce visual assets.

implement.purpose: Implement a scoped change with tests.

visual-check.purpose: Check rendered output against a reference or expectation.

deep-debug.purpose: Root-cause a failure that resisted ordinary debugging.
